rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase for RSO Units
rules.requirement: For rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the annual allowable rent increase is 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords may no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities; RSO and SCEP monthly surcharges may be passed through with proper written notice after registration.
rules.key_value: 3% annual allowable increase; RSO surcharge $1.61/month; SCEP surcharge $2.83/month

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

rules.exemptions: Non-RSO properties are not covered by the RSO rent increase calculator; the document directs users to contact the Housing Department about allowable rent increases for non-RSO properties.
rules.interaction: The page notes that state law separately requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
